stories.title: Leading the Way

stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 8 - not a blemish yet

stories.detail: Tim Harris climbed 193 - momentum like a rolling maul, no offence to the purists

stories.title: Away-Day Raid

stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 15, 16 & 17 - starting to look comfortable

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag
